subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 坦坦荡荡
evidence.excerpt_zh: 杏花春館之西度碧瀾橋為坦坦蕩蕩三楹前宇為素心堂後宇為光風霽月堂東北為知魚亭又東北為萃景齋西北為雙佳齋（圓明園冊）臣等謹按坦坦蕩蕩四十景之一也額為皇上御書聨曰源頭句詠朱夫子池上居同白樂天素心堂内額曰清虚靜泰與光風霽月萃景齋諸額皆御書知魚亭及雙佳齋額世宗御書萃景齋石上刋御製坦坦蕩蕩詩
evidence.summary: West over the 碧瀾橋: 坦坦蕩蕩 of three bays, 素心堂 in front, 光風霽月堂 behind, with 知魚亭, 萃景齋 and 雙佳齋 around. The poem is cut on a rock at 萃景齋.

evidence.title: 素心堂: 乾隆二十四年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆二十四年 (1759), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh:
山不在高水亦澄，秀兼山水趣偏胜。静参倪筦禽鱼适，悦可襟怀翰墨凭。征
士爱他即景句，羲经得我素心朋。虽然未敢眈闲逸，肯构恒斯励继绳。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 素心堂, 1759, on visits to the dowager. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 素心堂
evidence.locator: v2 p.46, under 坦坦荡荡; source ref 7-327
evidence.excerpt_zh: 书堂最为古，秋令又而今。松竹自良友，缥缃实素心。荷风清拂座，蕙露馥濡襟。散步延幽赏，莎蛩三两吟。
evidence.summary: Poem 素心堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1760, filed by the editors under 坦坦荡荡.

evidence.title: 素心堂: 乾隆三十二年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆三十二年 (1767), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 古屋园中咫尺近，一年堂上几回临。乍欣此日观佳景，都为宜时霈好霖。香喷缥缃插架润，响调琴瑟挂檐斟。在兹试问相应句，祇有祈农是素心。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 素心堂, 1767. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 素心堂: 嘉庆二十四年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆二十四年 (1819), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 考命继大统，夙夜矢敬钦。繁华性相远，实予之素心。所本在经籍，有暇即探寻。内省果不疚，外诱奚能侵。守成除妄想，惕若天难谌。君民情贯注，交泰孚惠深。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 素心堂, 1819. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 题素心堂
evidence.locator: v2 p.46, under 坦坦荡荡; source ref 10-688
evidence.excerpt_zh: 翠跸返行辕，芳辰驻御园。岂无花石赏，惟廑耙梨翻。颇厌招风柳，安求树背蘐。当春多望雨，正合素心存。
evidence.summary: Poem 题素心堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1770, filed by the editors under 坦坦荡荡.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 素心堂
evidence.locator: from p.145, under 坦坦荡荡
evidence.summary: 素心堂: 11 dated items, 1759-1819, of which 11 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: visits to the dowager. First dated 1759, last dated 1819.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v2, editors' note on 坦坦荡荡
evidence.summary: The goldfish pool on the west shore: gate hall of five bays 素心堂 with a three-bay annex, 半亩园 east, 澹怀堂 west, 知鱼亭, 萃景斋, 双佳斋, and the five-bay 光风霁月 in mid-pool.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
